fusions.name: Brought to Bay
fusions.desc: Your next weapon strike on an enemy at or below 30% health deals 22 piercing damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It deals 10% more for each ally beside you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Warning Bark
fusions.desc: Barks an alarm 3 tiles ahead that deals 4 resonating damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lead Them Off
fusions.desc: Draws up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Coursing Hound
fusions.desc: A hound runs at your side and bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds, slowing what it bites by 20% for 2 seconds.
